title: Automations
description: Start agents and workflows on a schedule, or when another system calls a signed webhook. Every start is recorded with its outcome.
readOnly: You can see automations and their history. Creating and changing them needs the admin role.
loadError: The automations could not be loaded.
empty: Nothing runs on its own yet
emptyBody: A schedule runs an agent or a workflow at fixed times; a webhook runs one when another system sends an event.

form.scheduleIntro: Runs an agent or a published workflow at fixed times, with the same input each time.
form.webhookIntro: Gives you an address other systems can call with a signed request; each event starts a run.
form.name: Name
form.publishedOnly: Automations run the published version of a workflow.
form.cronHelp: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday.
form.inputPlaceholder: What should each run work on?

signatureHelp.gouvra: Senders sign with the Gouvra-Signature header (timestamped HMAC-SHA256).
signatureHelp.github: For GitHub repository webhooks: X-Hub-Signature-256, with the delivery id.

form.templateHelp: Leave empty to pass the payload as is, or build the input from it, e.g. {{example}}.
form.overlapScheduleHelp: Skip a tick while the run started by the previous one is still going.
form.overlapWebhookHelp: Skip deliveries while a run is still going (events would be dropped).

secret.title: Your webhook is ready
secret.description: Give the sending system this address and signing secret.
secret.once: The secret is shown only now. Copy it to the sending system; you can replace it later.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another workspace.
detail.rotateBody: The current secret stops working immediately: update the sending system with the new one.
detail.deleteBody: It stops starting runs. The runs it started stay in the history.
detail.noUpcoming: No upcoming run while it is paused.
detail.overlapSkip: A tick is skipped while the previous run is still going.
detail.overlapAllow: Every tick starts a run, even if the previous one is still going.
detail.addressHelp: POST signed requests here. Retries of the same delivery never start a second run.
detail.githubHelp: In your repository: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, with this address, content type application/json and the secret.
detail.historyHelp: Every start, refusal and skip, newest first. Updates on its own.
detail.noHistory: No run yet: the first one comes at the next tick (or use “Run now”).
detail.noDeliveries: No delivery yet. Send one with the examples, or use “Send a test”.
